title: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Heat the oil/ghee over medium-high heat and saute the onion and carrots until soft.
Add the basil and saute for another 5 minutes, but do not let anything burn.
Add the tomatoes, chicken broth, 1 Tsp of salt, and black pepper, then pressure cook for 35 minutes.
Quick release then add half cup of cream, stir, the juice of 1 lemon, stir, and 1 Tablespoon of butter.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
reviewFlags: The source lists a pint of cream but calls for ½ cup in the method. It also calls for lemon juice that isn’t listed in the ingredients.
